disclaimer: Measurements describe only this exact workload and declared manifest. They are not a universal optimization, production recommendation, or savings claim.

metric_definitions.decision_throughput: arithmetic mean of repeated-block output-token throughput, paired with its Student-t block interval; pooled tokens/wall remains separately reported
metric_definitions.e2e_latency: client request start through validated terminal stream completion
metric_definitions.inter_chunk_latency: client-observed gap between nonempty SSE output chunks; explicitly not ITL
metric_definitions.itl: unavailable in native mode because SSE chunks do not prove token boundaries
metric_definitions.slo_decision_ci: Student-t 95% interval over repeated-block p95 values; request-bootstrap percentile intervals are diagnostic only
metric_definitions.slo_goodput: validated requests meeting every configured per-request SLO divided by measured block wall time
metric_definitions.throughput: validated completion tokens divided by measured block wall time
metric_definitions.tpot: first-to-last output-bearing SSE delta divided by completion-token gaps; unavailable unless at least two output-bearing SSE events are observed
metric_definitions.ttft: client request start to first non-whitespace output-bearing SSE delta; role-only chunks are ignored
